name: Waveshare ST3215-HS
description: Original manufacturer STEP geometry with eight components. Supplied disc pair shown by default; optional illustrative single arm.

catalog.sourceName: Waveshare ST3215-HS wiki; linked ST3215 dimension drawing and STEP

specifications.label: Interface
specifications.value: TTL serial bus, 1 Mbps; 360° magnetic position sensor

specifications.label: Drawing datums
specifications.value: 45.22 × 24.72 × 29 mm main case; 32 mm raised faces; 37.25 mm across supplied disc faces.

specifications.label: STEP rear pivot
specifications.value: An additional 0.55 mm below the disc gives 37.8 mm overall with discs; plain case height is not the wiki nominal 35 mm.

specifications.label: Original STEP geometry
specifications.value: Original case contours, shaft splines, motor, PCB and discs. Rear cover internal void shifted 0.00001 mm to repair a source topology defect; external surfaces unchanged. Source component overlaps are preserved; the optional single arm is illustrative.

specifications.label: Published current
specifications.value: No-load 0.24 A; locked rotor 2.4 A. Current test voltage is not stated.

specifications.label: Supply and control
specifications.value: 6–12.6 V; TTL serial bus, up to 1 Mbps; magnetic encoder, 360° positioning and continuous rotation modes.

specifications.label: Weight basis
specifications.value: 68 g from the product listing; accessory inclusion is not specified.

specifications.label: Mounting and envelope
specifications.value: Front pitch 20.7 × 20.5 mm; rear pitch 24.45 × 20.5 mm. Bare-output envelope height 36.3 mm; with supplied discs 37.8 mm.

specifications.label: Unavailable ratings
specifications.value: Motor type and spline tooth count are not established by the linked manufacturer sources.

name: KST X10 V8.0
description: Case 30 × 10 × 35.5 mm; 42 mm mounting span, 36 mm upper pitch; shaft projects 3.3 mm and its axis is 6.55 mm from the case end. Lower mounting hole lies 35.2 mm below the upper holes and centrally at 18 mm from either upper hole. The lower tab extends 6.4 mm below the main case, giving a 45.2 mm overall bare envelope. Upper hole centres are assumed halfway through the dimensioned 8 mm ears; lower tab rounding is derived from that assumption. Lower case relief, corner fillets and optional horn are simplified. Spline is 25T, Ø4.94 major / Ø4.25 root, with straight-flank approximation; no certified mating fit. No internal motor, gears or wiring.

name: Power-HD T60-BHV
description: Brushless Power-HD servo envelope with sourced 40.7 × 20.5 mm case footprint, 49 × 10 mm mounting centers and 25T output interface. Undimensioned fitting details remain illustrative.

catalog.sourceName: Power-HD T60-BHV specification V1, pages 2–3; reviewed 2026-09-14

specifications.label: Spline interface
specifications.value: 25T; drawing major Ø5.90 +0.02/−0 mm; table nominal Ø5.80 mm

specifications.label: Unspecified mounting details
specifications.value: Cutout diameter and opening throat are illustrative

specifications.label: Performance at 6.0 V
specifications.value: Stall torque 45 kgf·cm; no-load speed 0.098 s per 60°. No-load current 0.3 A. Stall current 2.1 A. Idle current 0.08 A.

specifications.label: Performance at 7.4 V
specifications.value: Stall torque 50 kgf·cm; no-load speed 0.089 s per 60°. No-load current 0.3 A. Stall current 2.5 A. Idle current 0.08 A.
